summary: No introduced defects found. The follow-matrix guard now fails closed when the maintenance index is unreadable, requires each plan reservation to bind to exactly one live or archived record, and adds focused tests for unreadable index evidence, missing or mismatched reservations, archived settlements, and a legacy absent index.

evidence: Base `src/host/matrix-artifact-wave.ts` already accepts an authenticated historical wave whose plan-bound runtime differs from the installed runtime, covering the parked 33 results.

Base `ops/hosted-autonomy-matrix-runtime-readmission.ts` is wired through `ops/hosted-autonomy-retry-pass.ts` and re-admits the parked runtime-mismatch rows with the same reservation, so no new charge is created.

Base `src/host/hosted-runtime-follow-matrix.ts` already contains `matrixWaveOpen` and the installed-runtime wave hold; this candidate adds fail-closed handling and archive/id binding rather than the task implementation.
